examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

items.wordHook: a 口(mouth) shouts 止(stop) as 易(change) swings a leg → 踢(kick).

examples.chinese: 新學期快要開始了。我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le. Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.english: The new semester is about to start. We start class at 8:40 every day.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 山本良介要從台北車站搭捷運回去。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè yào cóng Táiběi Chēzhàn dā jiéyùn huíqù.
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke wants to take the MRT back from Taipei Main Station.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 你畢業後要出國留學或是留在國內工作，都是不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìyè hòu yào chūguó liúxué huòshì liú zài guónèi gōngzuò, dōu shì bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: After you graduate, whether you go abroad to study or stay in the country to work, both are good choices.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó kāifàng guónèi tóuzī hòu, xiǎng tóuzī rénmínbì de rén yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
examples.english: After China opened up domestic investment, more and more people want to invest in RMB.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品，很多國內外的買家都十分感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn, hěn duō guónèi wài de mǎijiā dōu shífēn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: Many buyers, both domestic and foreign, are very interested in that painter's works.

examples.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén lìyòng xīnnián qījiān dào guówài lǚxíng, guónèi guònián de qìfēn jiù yuèláiyuè dàn le.
examples.english: Many people take advantage of the New Year period to travel abroad, so the atmosphere of celebrating the New Year domestically is becoming weaker and weaker.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 我收到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
examples.english: I received a notification from the fitness center; next month I will go be a fitness coach.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī de hěn hǎo, bànguò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

items.wordHook: Combining 流(flow) and 汗(perspiration): 流汗 means sweat.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shì yǐ àiqíng de tícái xiě chéng de, hòulái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làngmàn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This novel is written with a love theme, and was later made into a romantic movie.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 雲小姐最近突然開始化妝了，人也變美了。大家都猜她戀愛了。
examples.pinyin: Yún xiǎojiě zuìjìn tūrán kāishǐ huàzhuāng le, rén yě biàn měi le. Dàjiā dōu cāi tā liàn'ài le.
examples.english: Miss Yun recently suddenly started wearing makeup, and she has become prettier too. Everyone guesses that she is in love.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 今天是我的生日，媽媽準備了很多我愛吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, māma zhǔnbèi le hěn duō wǒ ài chī de cài.
examples.english: Today is my birthday; Mom prepared many dishes that I love to eat.

examples.chinese: 我最愛吃蘋果跟香蕉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài chī píngguǒ gēn xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: I love eating apples and bananas the most.

examples.chinese: 弟弟愛穿短褲，不愛穿長褲。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi ài chuān duǎnkù, bù ài chuān chángkù.
examples.english: My younger brother loves to wear shorts, not long pants.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸、媽媽有三個孩子，我最愛看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba, māma yǒu sān ge háizi, wǒ zuì ài kànshū.
examples.english: My parents have three kids. I like to read the most.

examples.chinese: 我愛吃水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ài chī shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I love eating fruit.

examples.chinese: 我愛你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ài nǐ.
examples.english: I love you.

examples.chinese: 新同學很可愛。
examples.pinyin: Xīn tóngxué hěn kěài.
examples.english: The new classmate is lovely.

examples.chinese: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so lovely.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 很可愛，友美喜歡可愛的東西。
examples.pinyin: Hěn kěài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān kěài de dōngxi.
examples.english: It’s very cute. Youmei likes cute stuff.

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 她是新同學，叫友美。她很可愛。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì xīn tóngxué, jiào Yǒuměi. Tā hěn kěài.
examples.english: She is our new classmate. Her name is Youmei. She is cute.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

items.wordHook: Under a 爫(claw) and a 冖(cover), a 心(heart) takes a 夊(slow step) → that care is 愛(love).

examples.chinese: 小王剛買了一臺電腦，有些功能還不太會操作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng gāng mǎi le yì tái diànnǎo, yǒuxiē gōngnéng hái bú tài huì cāozuò.
examples.english: Xiao Wang just bought a computer, and there are still some functions he doesn't really know how to operate.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

items.wordHook: 但(but) + 是(be) → 但是 means 'but'.
學(learn) + 校(school) → the place for learning: 學校(school).
A corner under the 广(broad) roof is 占(occupied) by a shop sign → the 店(shop).
When the bright 日(sun) disappears and only faint 音(sound) echoes across the black night → 暗(dark).
比(compare) + 賽(compete) → comparing and competing is a 比賽, a competition.
a 石(stone) rolls down a 宛(crooked) path and lands as a 碗(bowl).
a 穴(cave) swallows a 囪(chimney) → 窗(window).
臺(platform) + 灣(bay): a platform by a bay → the island of Taiwan.
